items.title: Mesh Hero Card
items.description: Vibrant dynamic mesh background scene with organically floating OKLCH color blobs and a glassmorphic hero callout.
items.recipe: The soft iridescent mesh is composed of several large geometric elements (.blob) colored in the OKLCH space, continuously moving and rotating along separate trajectory paths. The parent container with filter: blur(70px) organically blends them into a fluid gradient without muddy bleeding artifacts.

items.title: Glitch Cyber Buttons
items.description: Cyberpunk HUD panel with three angular clip-path buttons that RGB-split and glitch on hover, framed by scanlines and corner brackets.
items.recipe: The polygon-chamfered silhouette is sculpted via clip-path: polygon(). The RGB split glitch effect is driven by two pseudoelements (::before, ::after) cloning the button text, offset slightly horizontally and clipped to thin slices with clip-path: inset() using a rapid steps() keyframe loop.

items.title: Orbit Border Button
items.description: Call-to-action button with rotating conic-gradient border powered by CSS @property and an outer glowing duplicate blur.
items.recipe: The core mechanism relies on registering the custom CSS property @property --angle { syntax: '<angle>'; inherits: false; initial-value: 0deg; }. This allows smooth keyframe animation of the conic gradient rotation angle. A blurred duplicate pseudoelement placed behind generates the dynamic glowing aura.

items.title: Alpine Chalet Expedition Dashboard
items.description: High-altitude mountain chalet dashboard featuring rich walnut wood trims, summit weather telemetry, an interactive SVG elevation trail profile, and an expedition gear checklist.
techniques: walnut wood gradient borders and bevels
cream and alpine navy high-contrast palette
interactive SVG mountain elevation trail profile
items.recipe: The aesthetic merges dark walnut timber frames with crisp warm-cream interior panels and deep alpine navy typography. The elevation chart uses responsive SVG with interactive waypoints that update trail distance and difficulty stats.

items.title: Blacksmith Weapon Dossier
items.description: Heavy forged cast-iron weapon inspect card with glowing molten durability segments, socketed fire runes, and tactile metallic action buttons.
techniques: soot-blackened iron texture with chamfered metallic borders
dynamic stat diff comparisons with badges
items.recipe: The card silhouette utilizes dark slate and cast-iron linear gradients accented with molten amber borders. The durability indicator uses individual segments with glowing box-shadows, and the interactive rune sockets dynamically toggle elemental attack damage bonuses.

items.title: Botanical Herbarium Dossier
items.description: Victorian naturalist herbarium specimen dossier on deckled parchment paper, featuring vector botanical illustrations, interactive anatomy pins, and a taxonomy archive ledger.
techniques: vector SVG botanical specimen with hover pins
olive and aged-gold botanical color palette
items.recipe: The botanical archive aesthetic relies on warm aged-parchment linear gradients combined with delicate serif typography (Cormorant Garamond) and antique brass accents. The specimen card features interactive SVG anatomy pins that reveal naturalist observations and taxonomy classification stats.

items.title: Glass-4 · Hazy Segmented Border (Interactive Pro)
items.description: Result panel: interactive speedrun timer with telemetry sparkline, specular cursor spotlight, 3D X-Ray layer anatomy mode, and real-time CSS Physics Workbench.
items.recipe: The non-uniform glowing border uses a registered @property --border-angle driving a conic-gradient on ::before with 1px-2px padding, hollowed out via mask-composite: exclude. Atmospheric inner haze uses ::after with negative insets, 3 radial gradients, and dynamic blur. Enhanced with cursor-tracked specular lighting, micro-grain SVG noise, and an interactive 3D layer decomposition view.

items.title: Holo Foil Card
items.description: 3D interactive collectible card with pointer-tracking tilt, iridescent holographic sheen, and dynamic specular glare.
items.recipe: As the cursor moves, tilt angles (--rx, --ry) and glare origins (--px, --py) are calculated in real time. The holographic rainbow shimmer is created with a conic/linear spectrum overlay using mix-blend-mode: color-dodge, while a moving specular radial gradient mimics ambient light reflection.

items.title: Khaki Obsidian Pitch Deck Card
items.description: Ultra pitch-black card with deep murky swamp/khaki green haze glow, matte borders, and tactile telemetry widgets.
items.recipe: The interface achieves a profound dark mode by using true OLED pitch-black (#040604) rather than slate gray. A deep murky moss-green atmospheric haze is generated via multiple layered radial gradients and a 30px gaussian blur on ::after. Border segments use subtle olive/khaki gradients with mask-composite: exclude.

items.title: Rainy Cafe Journal & Soundscape
items.description: Cozy window-table cafe interface with glowing filament Edison bulbs, steaming coffee mug, lo-fi acoustic playlist, and coffeehouse journal notes.
techniques: warm Edison filament glow with radial-gradient diffusion
rain-slicked window glass overlay with car headlight bokeh
interactive acoustic lo-fi player with analog volume mixer
editorial cafe tasting notes and markdown scratchpad
items.recipe: The intimate cafe corner blends dark walnut tabletop textures with a glowing Edison pendant light. Animated SVG steam plumes rise from the porcelain coffee cup, while the background rain streaks and warm headlight bokeh evoke a quiet afternoon watching the storm from a bistro window.

items.title: Solar Flare Sunset Black Card
items.description: Pitch-black dashboard card bathed in an intense golden-hour solar flare haze, radiant amber rim light, and warm gradient typography.
items.recipe: The sunrise/sunset atmosphere is achieved by placing an expansive multi-color radial gradient (amber #ff9e00 to incandescent orange #ff4500 and deep purple) on a blurred ::after layer behind an absolute pitch-black (#040302) container. The upper rim features an acute conic highlight simulating direct sunlight glancing off chamfered glass.

items.title: Spotlight Card Grid
items.description: Interactive card grid where moving the cursor illuminates borders and textures across neighboring cards synchronously.
items.recipe: A pointermove listener on the parent container computes cursor coordinates relative to each card (--mouse-x, --mouse-y). Each card's ::before layer renders a radial gradient positioned at those coordinates, masked to the border perimeter. Neighboring cards are lit synchronously by a single unified beam of light.

items.title: Cyberpunk Terminal Search & Command Input
items.description: Tactical command palette input bar with slash command autocomplete tags, hotkey indicators, and neon scanline status bar.
items.recipe: The command search bar combines an elevated dark obsidian chassis with an animated neon cyan outline upon focus-within. It contains clickable quick-action chips that dynamically prepend commands (such as /search, /deploy, /config) directly into the input stream.

items.title: Glassmorphic Auth & OTP Input Form
items.description: Tactile frosted glass sign-in card with floating label inputs, automatic multi-box OTP verification codes, and focus glow rings.
items.recipe: The authentication card employs modern floating labels using the :not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label selector pattern to animate labels without JavaScript. The 4-digit OTP code inputs automatically advance focus on digit entry and highlight the active cell with an animated cyan ring.

items.title: Signal Loaders Pack
items.description: Curated collection of 6 distinctive telemetry loaders: radar sweep, oscilloscope wave, segmented LCD bar, conic ring, pulsing core, and orbiting dots.
items.recipe: Each telemetry loader demonstrates a distinct CSS animation technique: from rotating radar sweep sectors (conic-gradient mask) and oscilloscope sine waves (SVG stroke-dashoffset) to segmented LCD equalizer meters with staggered discrete animation-delay offsets.

items.title: Scroll-Driven Reveal Feed
items.description: Dark editorial feed: cards rise and unblur as they enter the viewport, plus a glowing reading-progress bar at the top.
items.recipe: Standard CSS keyframe animations are bound to scroll position: animation-timeline: view() drives the reveal while the card enters the viewport (animation-range: entry 0% cover 30%), while scroll(root) drives the sticky top progress bar. In browsers without support, an IntersectionObserver fallback activates the .in class.

items.title: Soft Toggle Set
items.description: Light neumorphic settings panel: 4 springy toggles + segmented mode picker; the panel accent reacts to checked state.
items.recipe: Neumorphic tactile depth is crafted with dual opposing box-shadows: a bright specular highlight top-left and a soft dark shadow bottom-right. State is managed purely with modern CSS: .panel:has(#t-focus:checked) redefines the --accent variable. The springy knob bounce is defined via linear() easing with graceful cubic-bezier fallback.

items.title: CRT Terminal Window
items.description: Retro hacker terminal window with phosphor green glow, curved screen vignette, animated scanlines, and typewriter output.
items.recipe: The CRT monitor appearance is produced by combining a peripheral radial-gradient vignette (simulating glass screen curvature) with an overlay repeating-linear-gradient for cathode ray scanlines. The phosphor green glow uses layered text-shadows, while the command prompt cursor blinks discretely with steps(1).

items.title: Frosted Grain Dialog
items.description: Native modal dialog featuring frosted glass aesthetics, SVG feTurbulence tactile grain noise, and top-layer transition-behavior animations.
items.recipe: The modal opens via the native HTML5 .showModal() API. Smooth top-layer entry transitions are animated with @starting-style and transition-behavior: allow-discrete. The tactile frosted glass grain texture is rendered by an inline SVG feTurbulence fractal noise filter composited with mix-blend-mode: overlay.

items.title: Rainy Window Chat
items.description: Atmospheric nocturnal messenger framed against rain-slicked window glass, featuring blurred streetlamp bokeh, translucent chat bubbles, and amber status indicators.
techniques: frosted glass panels with backdrop-filter: blur(20px)
golden streetlamp and neon violet bokeh halos
translucent message bubble layout with smooth scroll
items.recipe: The interface mimics looking through a rain-streaked cafe window at night. Subtle vertical linear gradients animate rain streaks in the background, while the chat window uses deep midnight glass panels with amber accent borders and glowing presence indicators.

items.title: Tavern Innkeeper Dialogue
items.description: RPG tavern interactive dialogue window framed in dark carved timber and beveled brass, with NPC dialogue, tavern rumors, and branching responses.
items.recipe: The dialogue interface uses dark timber backgrounds with inset box-shadows to simulate heavy carved wood. The dialogue choices are rendered as brass-trimmed wooden plaques that depress on click, swapping dynamic NPC responses and tavern rumor updates.

items.title: Glass Dock Menu
items.description: macOS inspired floating glass dock menu featuring neighbor icon magnification powered by modern CSS :has() selectors.
items.recipe: The graduated neighbor icon magnification without JavaScript is powered by pure CSS: combining :hover with the next-sibling selector (.item:hover + .item) and previous-sibling selector via :has() (.item:has(+ .item:hover)). The floating frosted glass dock chassis features backdrop-filter: blur(24px).

items.title: 8-bit Pixel Menu
items.description: Arcade 8-bit game main menu with stepped pixel border shadows, blinking cursor arrow, and keyboard navigation.
items.recipe: The authentic 8-bit stepped pixel border is constructed using multiple zero-blur box-shadow offsets, rendering pixelated stepped corners without external images. The blinking triangle cursor is controlled by keyboard Up/Down/Enter keys with discrete steps(1) animation.

items.title: Segmented Nav with Sliding Pill
items.description: Sleek glass segmented control with an active indicator pill that smoothly glides between options using CSS transitions.
items.recipe: The active sliding pill indicator is positioned dynamically using CSS custom properties --pill-left and --pill-width, smoothly transitioning with cubic-bezier curves when tabs change. The glass container features backdrop-filter: blur(20px) and a subtle top-edge specular highlight.

items.title: Chromatic Glitch RGB Split Typography
items.description: Distorted analog RGB-split chromatic glitch typography with horizontal scan slice tears and jitter displacement keyframes.
items.recipe: The chromatic aberration glitch is created without duplicating DOM nodes by utilizing data-text attributes on ::before and ::after pseudoelements. One layer carries a pure cyan text-shadow, the other red-magenta. Rapid @keyframes loops apply randomized clip-path: inset() horizontal slice windows, producing genuine VHS tracking tears.

items.title: Deep Liquid Sheen Metallic Typography
items.description: Liquid chrome specular typography featuring an animated gradient shimmer mask, 3D extruded lighting, and reflective edge bevels.
items.recipe: Liquid metal typography is crafted by applying a multi-stop metallic linear gradient across background-clip: text with an animated background-position loop. A high-pass filter drop-shadow gives physical 3D extrusion while keeping text fully selectable and accessible.

items.title: Neon Signboard Glow Typography
items.description: Authentic neon tube signboard typography with multi-layer luminous text-shadows, gas discharge bloom, and realistic intermittent flicker.
items.recipe: The authentic neon sign glow is engineered by combining five layered text-shadows ranging from a crisp white core to wide saturated neon magenta and violet halos. A sporadic @keyframes flicker animation randomly drops text opacity, simulating an irregular electrical discharge inside a noble gas neon tube.

items.title: AE86 Retro Digital Dash Cluster
items.description: Authentic 1980s Toyota AE86 Digital Meter replica built around a unified mathematical power-parabola tachometer curve: 56 high-visibility VFD bar segments, 65 normal-aligned comb ticks, bold 0-8 numerals, and unbroken perspective grid rays anchored mathematically to the curve.
techniques: Unified power-parabola equation y(u) = Y_flat + dY * (1 - u/8)^2.55 driving segments, ticks, numerals, and grid rays
Native svgElement.namespaceURI inheritance immune to markdown link-mangling
Dual-track tachometer spine: upper 65-tick fine scale + lower 56-brick VFD bargraph with peak-hold indicator
Daylight White Silkscreen (Photo 1) vs. Nighttime Red-Orange Stencil (Photo 2) + Amber & Synth Cyan themes
Web Audio API 4A-GE 16V twin-cam synthesizer + 105 km/h JDM Kin-Kon speed chime
items.recipe: The entire central tachometer and perspective grid are procedurally generated from a single parametric curve P(u) for u in [0, 8]. At each integer u = 0..8, the exact tangent and normal vectors are computed so the major numerals, comb ticks, VFD bricks, and architectural rays lock together with zero visual discontinuity.

items.title: Modern 1-DIN DSP Car Stereo Head Unit

techniques: Direct @font-face DSEG14-Classic & DSEG7-Classic italic matrix LCD typography
Conic-gradient spun-metal rotary encoder with 3 wrapping curved arc bezel buttons
Live 12-band segmented dot-matrix spectrum analyzer & illuminated badge strip ([EON], [BT], [LOUD], [SUB-W])
Tightly packed lower preset strip with under-bezel RGB lightguide wings and single DISP 5-zone color cycler
Recessed 3.5mm AUX jack and sliding vertical USB port cover with LED edge-lit slot
items.recipe: Synthesizes three iconic 1-DIN designs: the left cluster features a Jewel-lit SOURCE key and three curved arc buttons hugging a spun-aluminum volume encoder; the center piano-black acrylic lens houses a DSEG14 main readout, DSEG7 clock/date, and live spectrum bars; the lower edge packs slim sculpted preset keys above a multi-zone RGB lightbar.

items.title: Apothecary Reagents & Tinctures

aged apothecary paper label borders with serif typography
interactive cart mixing drawer with gold calculation
items.recipe: The apothecary shop atmosphere uses dark oak shelving frames accented with glowing fluid vials in emerald, amber, and violet. Each potion bottle is built using layered SVG silhouettes with animated liquid levels, accompanied by paper labels that depress when added to the cauldron mixing tray.

items.title: Blacksmith Forge & Tempering Station

techniques: glowing molten heat gradients with box-shadow bloom
dynamic flying ember spark particles on strike
cast-iron soot texture via multi-stop linear-gradients
segmented molten heat gauge with threshold alerts

The heat gauge uses segmented blocks whose border and shadow bloom shift from dull red to intense molten yellow as temperature rises. Clicking the strike button animates an array of flying ember sparks with randomized trajectories.

items.title: Blaupunkt Hamburg SQM 23 Head Unit
items.description: Authentic recreation of the Blaupunkt Hamburg SQM 23 DAB retro head unit with 14-segment LCD display, multi-color illumination toggle, cassette slot, and tactile preset buttons.
techniques: multi-color illumination switcher (green, amber, red, white, blue)
working volume encoder and rotary controls
dynamic frequency tuner and cassette bay
items.recipe: Recreates the iconic 80s Blaupunkt car stereo styling with authentic matte black chassis texture and a DSEG14 digital readout. Custom CSS variables dynamically switch the backlit key and LCD illumination between emerald green, classic amber, red, and ice blue.

items.title: Dynamic Island HUD
items.description: Morphing pill HUD inspired by iOS Dynamic Island with compact, media player, weather, and call states.
items.recipe: The morphing pill dynamically interpolates its dimensions and internal layout across states (compact, weather, player, call) using physics-inspired linear() easing. Sub-views transition seamlessly with coordinated opacity and transform scale keyframes.

items.title: Enchanted Alchemy Constellation
items.description: Bioluminescent botanical alchemy interface set in a deep conifer mist, featuring glowing constellation nodes, floating fireflies, and an interactive potion brewing alembic.
techniques: bioluminescent cyan/emerald glow with filter: drop-shadow
items.recipe: The enchanted forest mood combines deep pine-teal gradients with vibrant cyan/lime bioluminescence. Floating fireflies are driven by lightweight CSS keyframes with randomized sine drift and opacity pulsing. The central alembic potion bottle dynamically updates its fluid gradient and bubbling rate based on selected botanical nodes.

items.title: Holo-Glass Edge-Lit Data Slate (Interactive Pro)
items.description: Futuristic handheld terminal featuring an opaque tactical grip with multi-diode edge-projector LEDs, a transparent holographic glass display with real background refraction, procedural 3D wireframe terrain, click-to-place target beacon, 3D exploded layer view, and Web Audio tactical telemetry.
techniques: edge-projected directional light cone across transparent glass
dynamic CSS custom property RGB lighting & lumens overdrive
room blackout mode emphasizing luminescent holographic lines
procedural animated SVG 3D wireframe topographic mesh
synthesized Web Audio API sonar & tactile clicks

The grip's inner seam houses a multi-diode laser strip projecting a horizontal linear + radial gradient light cone powered by CSS custom properties (--glow-r, --glow-g, --glow-b, --beam-intensity). A world tactical map sits behind the glass to prove genuine backdrop-filter refraction.

items.title: LCD Stopwatch
items.description: Retro LCD stopwatch device: ghost-segment display, glow, scanlines, start/stop/lap/reset buttons and a lap list.
items.recipe: The authentic LCD display trick stacks two layers of the DSEG7 font in a single CSS grid cell: a dim ghost segment background reading 88:88.88 underneath, and bright illuminated digits on top. Because all DSEG glyphs share identical metrics, segments align perfectly with multi-layered text-shadow phosphor glow and scanlines.

items.title: Mars Wireframe HUD
items.description: Tactical mint-on-obsidian Mars orbital reconnaissance HUD featuring a true dual-layer 3D Fibonacci geodesic mesh (occluded back-hemisphere + foreground hemisphere), orbiting Phobos & Deimos moons, clickable surface landing beacons, interactive drag-to-rotate globe physics, and procedural Web Audio telemetry.
techniques: Dual-pass 2D Canvas 3D renderer splitting back-hemisphere (z < 0) behind the CSS planet and front-hemisphere (z >= 0) in front
Golden-angle Fibonacci sphere distribution with real-time mouse drag rotation and interactive GAIN / PHASE / ORBIT hardware knobs
3D surface landing beacons (Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, Jezero Crater) with screen-space reticle projection
Multi-layered CSS radial-gradient Mars globe with polar ice cap, atmospheric limb scattering, and terminator shadow
SVG dual-ring telemetry gauges, Tharsis topographic radar map, and Web Audio API orbital sonar synthesis
items.recipe: Fixes the original syntax bugs and upgrades the single flat canvas into a true depth-sorted 3D planetary system. Back-facing geodesic edges render on #meshBack behind the shaded Mars sphere, while front-facing edges, orbital rings, and surface beacons render on #meshFront. Clicking any beacon or dragging the globe updates the regional spectrometer, equalizer, and topographic map.

items.title: Midnight Library Archive Console

techniques: interactive banker's lamp light cone with toggleable pull chain
polished brass metallic bevels and trim
academic catalog search and manuscript inspector
items.recipe: The atmospheric research desk pairs dark mahogany woodgrain with an iconic green-glass banker's lamp that casts a directional warm pool of light. Clicking the brass pull-chain toggles the lamp's luminescent state via CSS variables, updating the ambient lighting across the desk and reading parchment.

items.title: Nocturne Gaslamp Night Reader
items.description: Photorealistic Victorian three-mantle cast-iron gas streetlamp and literary night reader featuring co-registered SVG volumetric light cones, interactive per-lantern ignition, raindrop-lit particle physics, wet cobblestone specular reflections, and procedural rain/gas audio synthesis.
techniques: Co-registered SVG coordinate space aligning 3 volumetric light cones directly to each lantern's glass housing
Detailed Victorian cast-iron post with wrought-iron scrollwork, beveled glass panes, and flickering incandescent gas mantles
HTML5 Canvas rain & moth particle physics that dynamically illuminate when passing inside the lamp's light cones
Physically reactive book page illumination driven by CSS custom properties (--gas-pressure) and lateral rim-lighting
Web Audio API procedural rain-on-cobblestone pink noise, distant bell resonance, and gas mantle hiss
items.recipe: By housing both the wrought-iron streetlamp geometry and the blurred volumetric light beams inside a single 280x440 SVG viewBox, the light cones originate at the exact coordinates of the three gas mantles (x=58, 140, 222). Adjusting the brass gas valve scales beam opacity, mantle bloom, wet cobblestone puddles, and the warm directional falloff across the adjacent reading page.

items.title: Pacific Drive Station Wagon Cluster
items.description: Modular survival station wagon cockpit inspired by Pacific Drive, split into independent bolt-on instrument windows with a 3D spherical liquid compass, interactive CRT chassis schematics, ignition/shifter controls, and anomaly storm simulation.
techniques: multi-window modular hardware pods with exposed ribbon cables and hex bolts
volumetric 3D spherical liquid compass with scrolling azimuth tape, meniscus bubble, and glass dome refraction
analog gauge needles with fixed calc() origin, illuminated ticks, and mechanical rolling odometer
curved phosphor CRT terminal with clickable car body parts and live repair tool workflow
procedural Web Audio engine rumble, Geiger clicks, and mechanical relay synthesis
items.recipe: Instead of a single flat box, the dashboard is decomposed into 5 distinct hardware enclosures mounted onto a structural steel rack over the misty Olympic Exclusion Zone windshield. The 3D liquid compass uses layered radial shading, a cylindrical scrolling degree strip inside a spherical clip mask, and a floating buoyancy bubble that reacts to steering and acceleration.

items.title: Paper Notification Stack
items.description: Tactile light-mode notification cards stacked with realistic layered paper shadows that fan out gracefully upon interaction.
items.recipe: Tactile stacked paper cards are created using progressive transform: translateY() scale() offsets paired with subtle multi-layer box-shadows. Hovering over the stack fans out the cards smoothly, while clicking dismisses the active top card with an exit swipe transition.

items.title: Tactical Police Radar HUD
items.description: Multi-window highway interceptor Doppler radar & LIDAR speed enforcement console featuring a 3-window DSEG7 digital cluster (Target, Locked Peak, Patrol Speed), interactive polar target scope with velocity vectors, live Doppler audio/waveform synthesizer, and automated ALPR citation log.
techniques: Triple DSEG7 7-segment displays with ghost segments (888) and color-coded LED states
Interactive polar radar scope with clickable moving vehicles, range rings, and LIDAR optical reticle
Police red/blue pursuit strobe lightbar reflections on ruggedized aluminum bezels
Real-time HTML5 Canvas Doppler frequency shift waveform and signal strength bargraph
Web Audio API pitch-proportional Doppler audio tone and violation lock buzzer
items.recipe: Inspired by Stalker Dual SL police cruisers, the console separates the polar Doppler/LIDAR scope, the triple 7-segment display head, and the ALPR violation logger into rugged dash-mounted pods. Fixing the original JS template literal bug, the unit calculates real closing speeds in Stationary or Moving patrol modes and lets operators click blips or fire instant-on RF triggers.

items.title: Rainy Night Soundscape Console

golden sodium vapor ambient lighting highlights

The frosted player utilizes backdrop-filter with subtle golden edge borders and animated equalizer bars driven by staggered CSS keyframes.

techniques: sunset mountain silhouette SVG layered backdrop
SVG topographic contour line map with interactive trail waypoints
rotating brass compass needle synced to selected waypoints
tactile brass map corner weights and forest-green palette
real-time park trail dispatch and fire danger telemetry

An interactive SVG contour map features trail waypoints that dynamically rotate a physical-styled brass compass needle to the waypoint's azimuth angle.

Real-time parametric orbital motion with dynamic SVG inter-satellite laser relay links and ground downlink cones
Backdrop-filter frosted glass cards with live telemetry sparklines and SVG spacecraft thumbnails
Interactive Anomaly Resolution sequence that fires RCS thrusters to normalize orbital deviation and thermal load
Synchronized selection state across fleet manifest, orbital markers, RF spectrum bars, and payload diagnostics

Switching between 3D, 2D, and Ground views morphs the globe container and recalculates marker projections in real time, while clicking Respond executes an automated orbital correction maneuver.

items.title: Solar System Orbit Atlas

techniques: 3D CSS preserve-3d orbital plane with billboarding counter-rotation so planets stay spherical at any camera tilt
Real-time requestAnimationFrame Keplerian orbit solver with dynamic SVG telemetry leader lines tracking moving planets
Rich CSS radial-gradient planetary atmospheres, terminator shadows, and 3D tilted Saturn & Uranus rings
Interactive camera pitch/yaw drag control, Time-Warp speed multiplier, and synchronized relative diameter scale strip
Procedural Web Audio API deep-space harmonic resonance per planet orbital frequency
items.recipe: Upgrades the static 6-ring CSS animation into a complete 8-planet + Asteroid Belt interactive 3D orrery. A JavaScript ephemeris loop drives orbital angles while counter-rotating each planet billboard against the plane's rotateX(--tilt) angle. Hovering or locking any card or orbit draws a live SVG callout line directly from the card to the moving planet's screen-space coordinates.

items.title: Orbital Space Navigation HUD

Mouse-coupled 6-DOF gimbal pitch ladder, roll scale protractor, and Flight-Path-in-the-Sky tunnel gates
Scrolling vertical aviation telemetry tapes (Orbital Velocity km/s & Periapsis Altitude km)
Interactive 3-channel Reactor Power Distributor (SYS / ENG / WPN) and 3D isometric Gravidar contact radar
Procedural Web Audio API warp core spooling, target lock acquisition chimes, and thruster telemetry

CSS transform Exploded Assembly View separating the 5 station levels vertically along the central truss axis
